page.overview:
Who is Sev?

Sev was a Weequay male Jedi Master who served as a general during the Clone Wars. During the war, he trained the Human Joc Sah as his Padawan. In the war's final year, Sev and Sah were sent to the Outer Rim planet Ragmar V, which was considered an essential staging world for the Republic's planned attack on a Separatist base.

Sev remained aboard a Venator-class Star Destroyer and sent Sah on his first solo mission to secure an outpost on the surface. Shortly thereafter, the clone troopers under Sev's command were ordered by Supreme Chancellor Palpatine to execute Order 66, a directive branding the Jedi Knights traitors to the Republic. Sev defended himself briefly, but was eventually slain by the clones.

Sev, a Weequay male, was born during the final decades of the Galactic Republic. He was trained in the ways of the Force by the Jedi Order and eventually ascended to the rank of Jedi Master. During this time, he took the Human Joc Sah as his Padawan. Sev served as a Jedi General in the Grand Army of the Republic. In 19 BBY, the final year of the war, Sev and Sah were dispatched to Ragmar V, a planet in the Outer Rim, which was viewed as a vital staging world for a planned Republic assault on a Separatist base. Sev stayed aboard a Venator-class Star Destroyer and sent Sah, accompanied by Clone Sergeant Remy and a clone trooper squad, on his first solo mission to the surface of the planet.

As Sah and his troops entered the atmosphere, Sev ordered him to secure an outpost and warned his Padawan to remain on his guard. Shortly thereafter, the ARC trooper accompanying Sev received a directive from Supreme Chancellor Palpatine commanding him to execute Order 66, which labeled the Jedi Knights traitors to the Republic. Sev was attacked by the clones under his command but defeated many of them before being overwhelmed and killed. After the Jedi Master's death, the ARC trooper sent a detachment of clones to eliminate Sah, who defeated his clone squad.
